items.summary: The pharmaceutical company rode one copycat drug to record profits. Now, co-chairman G.V. Prasad has to prove the company can grow without it. Biosimilars and innovation may hold the answer.

items.title: India's sugar industry body shares a positive price outlook
items.summary: Retail sugar prices are expected to decrease soon as speculative stocking eases. The industry body attributes recent price hikes to speculation and weather-related production issues. Domestic sugar stocks are currently estimated below the government's normative buffer level. The government has permitted duty-free raw sugar imports to address supply concerns.

items.title: SoftBank plans $6.3 billion retail bond sale in Japan next month, moves to raise funds for OpenAI commitments
items.summary: SoftBank Group is planning a record $6.3 billion retail bond sale next month, the biggest by any issuer in Japan, in order to raise funds to fulfil its investment commitments to OpenAI, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Global Markets | Japan's Nikkei weighed down by AI stocks ahead of Nvidia earnings
items.summary: The Nikkei share average in Japan experienced a downturn as stocks related to artificial intelligence faced mounting pressure due to inflation concerns and geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East. While chip-making firms such as Tokyo Electron reported gains, other AI companies struggled. Anticipation builds around potential interest rate hikes from the Bank of Japan, with Nvidia's forthcoming earnings report seen as pivotal for the tech sector.

items.title: Interventions hold rupee on narrow leash, traders await US sanctions on Iran
items.summary: The Indian rupee showed little movement on Monday, remaining steady in a limited range due to ongoing central bank actions. Market participants are keenly observing potential U.S. sanctions on Iran, while the continuing conflict in the Middle East poses risks to oil prices and India's import reliance. Meanwhile, the dollar index gained strength, contrasting with declines in most Asian currencies and regional equities.

items.title: Govt lifts wheat export ban with immediate effect
items.summary: The government has allowed exports of wheat flour and other products like maida and semolina, according to notifications of the Directorate General of Foreign Trade.

items.title: India eyes 14-fold jump in electronic component production by FY31: Report
items.summary: India aims for USD 500 billion in electronics production by FY31. Electronic component production is projected to reach USD 150 billion, a significant increase. Mobile phone manufacturing will also grow substantially, reaching USD 159 billion by FY31. Other categories like consumer electronics and IT hardware will see considerable expansion. This growth signifies India's expanding electronics manufacturing capabilities across diverse products.

items.title: Multibagger defence stock Apollo Micro System acquires 34% stake in defence tech company
items.summary: Apollo Micro Systems acquired a 34% stake in Shauryastra Defence Systems, investing ₹34,000 for 3,400 equity shares. The venture, focused on defence technology, will be led by Dr V. K. Saraswat and aligns with the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.

items.title: UPI completes 10 years, clocks nearly 13,000-fold rise in transaction volume
items.summary: UPI has completed a decade of transforming India’s digital payments ecosystem, with annual transactions surging from 1.78 crore in 2016-17 to 24,162 crore in 2025-26. Transaction value rose to Rs 314 lakh crore, while monthly volumes hit a record 2,366 crore in July 2026. UPI now operates across 11 countries and accounts for nearly 49% of global real-time payments.

items.title: Bitcoin surges 22% in a week, climbs to nearly $78K as US Treasury bond-buying plan boosts sentiment
items.summary: Bitcoin surged nearly 22% over the past week, trading near $78,000 on Monday, as the US Treasury’s bond-buying plan boosted market sentiment. Bitcoin was last at $76,896. Ethereum gained 1.37% over 24 hours, while Bitcoin rose 0.90%. Among major altcoins, BNB, Solana, Tron and Cardano advanced up to 0.90%, while XRP, Hyperliquid and Dogecoin climbed up to 1.96%.

items.title: Gold, Bitcoin or Stocks: Who’s winning the 2026 race for returns?
items.summary: Gold, Indian equities and bitcoin have delivered sharply different returns in 2026. Bitcoin has led the recent rally, gaining 27% over both the past week and month, but remains down 8% year-to-date. Gold has emerged as a stronger performer, while Indian equities have lagged across the period.

items.title: Stock market today: Sensex falls 170 points, Nifty 50 ends below 24,219; metal stocks shine
items.summary: The Sensex ended at 77,369, down 172 points, or 0.22%, while the Nifty 50 closed 33 points, or 0.14%, lower at 24,219.05. The Nifty Midcap 150 index inched up by 0.07%, while the Smallcap 250 index declined 0.21%.

items.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 24 Aug: BLS International, Balrampur Chini Mills, HAL, Bank of Baroda among top losers
items.summary: On August 24, the Indian stock market fell, reflecting global downturns and local selling pressure in major sectors. The Nifty 50 index dropped 0.36%, and crude oil prices eased as uncertainty loomed from anticipated US sanctions on Iran.

items.summary: Plaud's expansion into India comes at a time when India's wearables market is estimated to hit $3.6 billion this year.

items.title: Not just Leh, Ladakh could get two new airports soon; Thoise may start flights by December and Kargil later
items.summary: Ladakh is working to expand commercial air connectivity beyond Leh, with Thoise targeting flights by December and Kargil being assessed for civilian operations later. The plans could make remote destinations such as Nubra, Turtuk, Drass and Kargil easier to reach while supporting tourism and local economic activity.

items.title: Before Xi Jinping's likely India visit, Chinese money is pouring in
items.summary: India is cautiously reopening economic channels with China as Chinese linked investment returns after years of restrictions following the Galwan clash. More than $500 million has entered under revised investment rules, while NSA Ajit Doval’s Beijing visit and Xi Jinping’s expected India visit signal improving diplomatic ties. India is balancing economic cooperation with national security safeguards and strategic scrutiny.

items.title: Air passenger service prices rise 32% in June quarter; rail fares up 3.5%
items.summary: During the June quarter, there was a striking 32 percent year-on-year increase in air passenger service prices, the steepest rise amongst seven essential services tracked. Meanwhile, railway passenger prices rose by 3.50 percent and banking services saw a 6.90 percent inflation. Interestingly, both securities transactions and certain banking services experienced deflation. The upcoming producer price index data aims to accurately capture changes in producer-level pricing.

items.summary: Business owners in both countries are navigating uncertainty and worry as the tit-for-tat import taxes ratchet up.

items.title: More cars, thinner margins: Why rising sales aren’t boosting automakers’ profits
items.summary: Indian car makers see strong sales volumes, but profits are declining. Rising commodity prices and currency shifts are impacting manufacturer margins. Maruti Suzuki's profits fell despite record sales, showing margin erosion. Tata Motors and Hyundai also reported lower profits due to cost pressures. Automakers are investing heavily in new technologies and plants, affecting current earnings.

The funds raised will go towards establishing a new billet manufacturing facility, thereby boosting its backward integration.

items.summary: Rakesh Gangwal has committed an additional Rs 300 crore to IIT Kanpur's medical school. This significant funding follows his previous Rs 100 crore contribution in 2022. The institute plans to establish a super-speciality hospital and a cancer research centre on campus. These facilities will foster interdisciplinary collaboration between engineers and medical professionals. The Gangwal School aims to advance medical education and healthcare innovation across India.

items.summary: India's corporate investment cycle now features financially stronger companies expanding capacity. These well-capitalized groups are using internal cash flows for growth and consolidation. This differs from the earlier debt-heavy boom which relied on bank financing. HSBC India's balance sheet is expanding significantly, crossing five lakh crore rupees. Global capital flows require fresh triggers like reforms or FDI announcements.

items.summary: Indian government bonds remained steady as traders awaited oil price movements. US sanctions on Iran could impact global crude prices significantly. Higher oil prices may fuel inflation and widen India's current account deficit. Reserve Bank of India policymakers are open to raising interest rates. Swap rates saw little activity after a substantial spike last week.

items.title: ET Masterclass vs other online learning platforms: What makes it different?
items.summary: ET Masterclass differentiates itself in the crowded online learning market by focusing on practical application and real-world relevance for professionals and business leaders. It offers diverse learning formats, including live sessions and immersive experiences, taught by recognized experts and industry practitioners. The platform emphasizes actionable frameworks and case studies to help learners translate knowledge into effective decision-making for evolving career and business landscapes.

items.title: Health Ministry announces medical device regulatory reforms for ease of doing business
items.summary: The Ministry of Health has introduced new regulations for medical devices. These reforms simplify requirements and enhance transparency for businesses. Outsourced sterilisation rules are now easier for manufacturers to follow. Uniform testing fees and recognized EU jurisdictions reduce ambiguity. These changes facilitate timely access to advanced medical technologies in India.

items.title: Explained: What Oriental Hotels’ merger with IHCL means for shareholders
items.summary: IHCL will merge Oriental Hotels into itself through an all-stock transaction, with Oriental Hotels shareholders set to receive 25 IHCL shares for every 117 shares held. The merger will bring seven hotels and 825 rooms into IHCL’s standalone portfolio, while simplifying the group structure and creating operational and cost synergies.

items.title: India lifts export ban on wheat flour, related products with immediate effect
items.summary: The Central Government has lifted the export ban on wheat flour and related products. This policy amendment allows for immediate overseas shipments of these items. Previously, India had halted wheat exports in July 2022 due to rising local prices. Global price skyrocketed when the Russia-Ukraine conflict had impacted wheat trade significantly. The government had previously set a 5 million tonne export limit earlier this year.

items.title: India, Gulf bloc discuss next steps on free trade agreement
items.summary: India and the Gulf Cooperation Council reviewed free trade agreement negotiations in Riyadh. Discussions focused on strengthening bilateral relations and regional developments. Both sides affirmed the importance of continued coordination for stability. The GCC is India's largest trading partner bloc by far. Bilateral trade reached USD 178.56 billion in 2024-25.

items.summary: Markets are increasingly pricing in a more hawkish European Central Bank as geopolitical tensions, elevated energy costs and depleted gas inventories threaten to keep eurozone inflation high. Investors see a rising probability of further rate hikes through 2027, while resilient economic activity and fading disinflationary forces add to the case for tighter policy.

Beijing is shifting support toward technology sectors, but analysts expect the housing market’s prolonged correction to weigh on economic growth for years.

This new Service Producer Price Index offers an early view of producer-level price movements. The index currently covers only seven selected services across India.

The US Food and Drug Administration conducted this routine inspection from August 17-21, 2026. Four procedural observations were noted during the Seymour, USA facility's review. The company will provide its response to the USFDA within the required timeframe.

items.title: Urban Company shares surge 7% to 11-month high, rally 16% in 2 sessions. Here are 2 reasons why
